verdict.rationale: The Solo 2 GitHub repo documents an official `solo2` CLI with concrete commands: listing devices, a signed and SHA-256-verified firmware `update`, and admin settings such as LED colors. The bit-rot probe concerns the separate Solo 1 `solo-python`/`solo1-cli` tool, so it does not contradict the Solo 2 CLI, though it lowers confidence about upkeep. Missing for 10: hands-on runtime verification of the solo2 CLI, a full command reference, and machine-readable/agent-friendly output documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: solo2 list                   # list connected devices  (alias: solo2 ls)
`update` downloads the signed release, **verifies its SHA-256**, and flashes it.
solo2 app admin set led 007f7f 00007f # set led to teal (idle) / blue (active)
